context.body: Prophets, judges, kings, households, and assemblies pray while public events keep moving around them. The bounded source is 2 Chronicles 33:10–20.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Manasseh humbles himself and prays in affliction.
observations.label: Manasseh prays after violence, idolatry, and captivity: action

observations.body: restoration and later reforms are narrated after his prior violence and idolatry.

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 33:10–20 as prayer inside israel’s story evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Restoration and reform follow humility and prayer, while the earlier damage and later incomplete removal remain part of his story.
